title: Stable Continuous-Time Consistency Distillation: An Empirical Study with a Multistep Extension
abstract: arXiv:2610.34704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous-time consistency models are an attractive route to few-step generation. They remove the discretization error inherent to the timestep grid that discrete-time consistency models depend on. Until recently, however, training them was unstable. Lu & Song (2025) address this with the TrigFlow formulation and a coordinated set of architectural and training-objective changes. We conduct an independent empirical study of this framework on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64. No open-weight TrigFlow teachers exist at these scales, so we train them from scratch and then verify the consistency distillation (sCD) and consistency training (sCT) behavior of students initialized from these teachers. On CIFAR-10, our students reproduce the reported FID at one and two steps. On ImageNet-64, they fall short, a gap that appears related to our teacher and to architectural choices the paper leaves unspecified. We also report a parameter-count gap of about 5%

translated_title: 稳定的连续时间一致性蒸馏：一项实证研究与多步扩展
translated_abstract: 连续时间一致性模型是实现少步数生成的一条颇具吸引力的路径。它们消除了离散时间一致性模型所依赖的时间步网格中固有的离散化误差。然而直到最近，训练这类模型仍然是不稳定的。Lu & Song（2025）通过 TrigFlow 公式化以及一系列相互配合的架构与训练目标改动解决了这一问题。我们在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-64 上对该框架进行了独立的实证研究。由于在这些规模上不存在开源权重的 TrigFlow 教师模型，我们从零开始训练教师模型，随后验证了由这些教师初始化的学生模型在一致性蒸馏和一致性训练中的表现。在 CIFAR-10 上，我们的学生模型在一步和两步生成中复现了所报告的 FID 结果；而在 ImageNet-64 上则未能达到，这一差距似乎与我们的教师模型以及论文中未明确说明的架构选择有关。此外，我们还报告了约 5% 的参数量差距。
tldr: 本文对 Lu & Song 的 TrigFlow 连续时间一致性模型框架进行了独立实证研究，通过从零训练教师模型验证了 sCD/sCT 在 CIFAR-10 上可复现已有结果但在 ImageNet-64 上存在差距，并据此提出了多步扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an independent empirical study of Lu & Song's TrigFlow continuous-time consistency framework, training teachers from scratch to show that sCD/sCT reproduce reported results on CIFAR-10 but fall short on ImageNet-64, along with a multistep extension.
